home_yes_text: For Palestinian refugee families in Greece, the authorities said “yes”. The reunion has still not happened, because the responsible ministries are not taking the next steps.
home_yes_right_text: The authorities have recognised the right to family reunification.

about_story_lede: The story of a fellowship that began at a council and reached the far edge of Middle-earth.
about_team_lede: Nine set out from Rivendell. Six introduce themselves here; the rest are still on the road.
about_team_empty: The team will be introduced here soon.
about_story_opening: It all began at a council in Rivendell, when nine walkers decided that no one would go alone.
about_story_p1: In autumn we gathered beneath Elrond’s beeches. Elves, dwarves, men and hobbits, each with their own story and the same fear: that the road ahead was too long for one.
about_story_p2: A small hobbit stood up first. He did not know the way, he said, but he would find it. From that moment the quest stopped being one person’s burden and became everyone’s.
about_story_p3: We crossed mountains, mines and rivers. We got lost, we were scattered, we found each other again. We learned that fellowship is measured not in miles but in hands reaching out when someone falls.
about_story_p4: And when the journey ended, all we wanted was what every family wants: to go home and sit at the same table again.
